purpose: Curated minimum expected semantic facts for the current extractor. These examples use real cards from data/processed/cards/normalized/cards_normalized.json.
notes: These examples are not complete card parses. They define the minimum facts the semantic extractor must recover for representative language patterns.
Each expected fact should map back to an exact source line and evidence substring.
The same source line can produce trigger_observed, cost_or_requirement, event_produced, payoff_output, and state_or_modifier facts linked by clause_group_id.

examples.name: Harnessed Dragon
examples.why: Simple self-play trigger that produces an enemy unit death event.

source_lines.line_text: When you play me, kill an enemy unit.

examples.name: Altar of Memories
examples.why: Friendly death trigger with optional exhaust cost and multiple deck payoffs.

source_lines.line_text: When a friendly unit dies, you may exhaust me to draw 1, then put a card from your hand on the top or bottom of your Main Deck.

minimum_expected_facts.evidence: put a card from your hand on the top or bottom of your Main Deck

examples.name: Battle Mistress
examples.why: Two independent triggers on one card: rune recycle creates a token, enemy death readies self.

source_lines.line_text: When you recycle a rune, you may exhaust me to play a Gold gear token exhausted.
When one or more enemy units die, ready me.

minimum_expected_facts.evidence: play a Gold gear token exhausted
When one or more enemy units die

When you play this, play a ready 3 :rb_might: Sprite unit token with [Temporary] to your base.
[Deathknell][>] Repeat this gear's play effect. (When this dies, get the effect.)

play a ready 3 :rb_might: Sprite unit token with [Temporary] to your base
